title: ODDFPRICE: 10 of 10 and 5 of 5, both the repair's own validation artifacts

upstream_anchor.section: Validation (live Excel 16.0 b20026, G6 three-way ledger: OxFunc / F# / Excel)

status_plain: ODDFPRICE shared the base.powf integer-exponent bug with PRICE, and adding binary exponentiation fixed it. Two figures record the outcome: bit-exact on all 10 cases across the five-basis matrix, and bit-exact 5 of 5 on the US 30/360 integer-exponent ladder. Both are the repair's own validation artifacts -- the 10 cases sit under a heading whose first word is Validation, and the 5 are a named regression pin -- so both carry the repair-target flag. Neither is held out and no fresh ODDFPRICE corpus exists. Both figures are printed under a row and a stream titled for ODDFYIELD, which is the surface that did NOT get fixed; the misfiling is the trap here.
